messages:
carla_security: Eva from the auditor team pinged me — they need a packaged evidence set for SOC 2 / ISO review. Items called out: RBAC change history, who approved changes, audit log exports, KMS key rotation records, vuln triage notes, and a control mapping file. Can we assemble owners and ETA?

eva_auditor: Hi all — yes, please include: 1) control mapping table (SOC2 CC6 & ISO A.9 entries) 2) CSV manifest with SHA256s 3) raw audit log slices (last 12 months) + sample queries 4) KMS rotation events + CloudTrail snippets 5) vuln triage tickets + timeline. Prefer a single tarball and a manifest.json listing files and owners.

dmitri_infra: ack. Quick notes on locations: RBAC changes = github org repo "org-infra" PRs labeled `security/rbac` (search query: `label:security/rbac merged:>=2025-03-01`). Audit logs = Splunk index `infra_audit`, saved search `auditor_export_12m`. KMS rotation events are in CloudTrail (eventName=RotateKey or ScheduleKeyDeletion not expected) and also in AWS KMS console -> Key rotation tab.

dmitri_infra: sample export cmd for CloudTrail snippets:```\naws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=DisableKeyRotation --start-time 2024-03-01 --end-time 2026-03-19 --max-results 50\n```

alice_k: I'll take packaging + upload. Plan: 1) pull PR diffs and signed approvals into `evidence/rbac_prs/` 2) run Splunk saved search, export gzipped json to `evidence/audit_logs/` 3) pull CloudTrail snippets into `evidence/kms/` 4) collect vuln tickets (Jira) into `evidence/vuln/` 5) create `manifest.json` with SHA256s and `control_mapping.csv`. I'll upload to a restricted S3 bucket and generate a presigned review link. ETA EOD tomorrow unless blockers.

ben_platform: add Confluence doc `Security / Audit / Control Mapping` — contains living mapping to SOC2/ISO identifiers. I'll export the latest CSV (column headers: control_id, framework, owner, artifact_refs). Note: need to redact any PII from vuln ticket attachments before packing. Also confirm retention window for logs is compatible with auditor request (12 months).

carla_security: owners so far: RBAC PRs => dmitri_infra; packaging/upload => alice_k; control mapping export => ben_platform; vuln triage artifacts => ben_platform + sec-oncall. Eva: is the presigned S3 link OK or do you need a different transfer method (ShareFile / encrypted zip via vendor)?

eva_auditor: presigned S3 is fine if access is scoped and time-limited. Please include SHA256 in manifest and a short README describing how files map to controls. Also include the Splunk saved search definitions and at least two sample queries used to extract events.

dmitri_infra: noted. For the Splunk export I'll attach the saved search JSON and the export command we used. Example query to find RBAC grant events: `index=infra_audit event_type=rbac action=grant | table _time user target_role request_id`

ops-bot: File uploaded by alice_k: s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-20/evidence_part1.tar.gz (restricted)

alice_k: uploaded manifest.json and README.md to the bucket. Manifest includes file list, SHA256s, owners, and control refs. Link and access policy sent to `@eva_auditor` via secure channel.

carla_security: great. Last item: KMS key metadata. Dmitri — can you include key policy snapshots and the last two rotation events with CloudTrail event IDs? Auditor wants proof of rotation and KMS owner.

dmitri_infra: will attach key policy snapshots and two CloudTrail event JSONs. I'll redact ARNs that contain personal emails and replace with templated placeholders in README.

ben_platform: I'll coordinate vuln ticket redaction and add a short summary for each triage item: severity, fix deployed (y/n), dates, and PR refs.

carla_security: timeline check — aim to deliver full package with manifest and control mapping by 2026-03-21 17:00 UTC. If anything slips, ping me. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
